title: Group hostnames by department
hints: Loop over the devices, compute the group key for each, and append the hostname to that key's list.
(device.get("department") or "").strip() or "unassigned" turns missing, None and blank into the same key in one line.
groups.setdefault(key, []).append(hostname) creates the list the first time and returns the existing one afterwards. Skip a device before that line when its hostname is None.
